answer.evidence: radon/metrics.py holds the Halstead conversion. Lines 42-49 document the formulas. Lines 79-81 compute volume = N*log2(h) if h != 0 else 0, difficulty = (h1*N2)/float(2*h2) if h2 != 0 else 0, and effort = difficulty*volume. Lines 93-94 compute time = effort/18 and bugs = volume/3000. h_visit and h_visit_ast at lines 25 and 32 feed the counts in. mi_compute (line 98) guards zero volume. A grep for volume, difficulty, bugs and effort found 21 hits in metrics.py and none in raw.py, complexity.py or visitors.py. I did not read the handoff_refs files or the other three candidate files, so the split for A, B and D is a judgment, not a measurement. D gets more time than A and B because it is probably where the operator and operand counts are collected.
